queries.query: What does Islam say about backbiting?

It was said to him: What is your opinion about this that if I actually find (that failing) in my brother which I made a mention of? He said: If (that failing) is actually found (in him) what you assert, you in fact backbited him, and if that is not in him it is a slander

top_10.source_excerpt: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?" ﴾68﴿

top_10.title: Ar-Rūm
top_10.source_excerpt: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith]. ﴾60﴿

top_10.title: Al-Baqarah
top_10.source_excerpt: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh] ﴾45﴿

top_10.title: Yūnus
top_10.source_excerpt: And follow what is revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and be patient until Allāh will judge. And He is the best of judges. ﴾109﴿

top_10.title: An-Naḥl
top_10.source_excerpt: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied. ﴾42﴿

top_10.title: Al-Baqarah
top_10.source_excerpt: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. ﴾255﴿
